text: Should the attribute be emitted unconditionally, or only on TFMs where it is believed to be missing?
options: Unconditional: ExcludeFromCodeCoverage is available in netstandard2.0 and net4x, so no #if is needed
Keep the #if guard, but write it so it excludes only truly unsupported targets (such as net35)
why_it_matters: If unconditional is acceptable, the current guard is a defect: netstandard2.0 and .NET Framework users do not get the attribute, so the requirement is not met. If the guard was meant for old targets, the finding becomes narrower.
